textNotes.text: Dragonwilds is close to its official 1.0 release. I wanted to discuss some of the features that are missing that I would like to see as well as features that could be reworked in some way to add plenty of QoL to the title.
I've been covering Dragonwilds since day one, following every update, reveal, patch, and development milestone, so I'll also share insights and details that many new players may have missed.
